_comment: How AI PMC squads play a raid (DESIGN.md §4.4), loaded by PmcAi (checked on load: PmcAi.problems()). personalities: what a squad is like, rolled once per squad by weight. Per personality: name; weight; pois (how its 2-4 points of interest are picked: count [min, max]; tier_values: what a tier 1 / 2 / 3 POI is worth to it, 0-1; the weights of tier, distance (path metres from where it is, against), heat (a POI's PointOfInterest.heat(): fights and events), centre (near the middle of the map), quiet (far from hot POIs: tier 3 or a fresh raid event) and random; quest: it visits the map's quest_targets; knows_hidden: hidden POIs count for it; hidden: what a hidden POI it knows is worth to it, 0-1, instead of its tier's value); investigate (chance it goes to look at a hostile noise it hears, by kind: gunshot (and explosions), footstep (and rolls), voice); investigate_within (metres from it, 0: any it hears); investigate_near_route (metres from the route it's on, 0: anywhere); avoids_noise (it hides from noises within avoid_within metres instead); hunts (it runs to gunfire and keeps after whoever it hunts); rush (chance it heads for a raid event), rush_within (metres, 0: any it hears), rush_needs_quiet (only when nothing has been seen or heard for plan.avoid_quiet seconds); scavs: fight or avoid (hides from Scavs it sees unless they attack it); movement (sprint: travels sprinting; crouch_near_poi: metres from a POI within which it crouch-walks; crouch_along_cover: crouch-walks from cover to cover); leave_window: the raid share it plans to leave at, [min, max]; bag_full: the share of its rig, pocket and backpack cells that sends it out. default_personality: what a PMC without a plan reacts like (raid events). quest_targets: a map's Quester objectives (1-2 POI ids). gear_tiers: the kit a squad rolls (in order, cheapest first): rarity (multipliers on every gear roll, indexed by rarity), ammo_rarity ([-1, -1]: the everyday round), helmet_chance, backpack_chance, pistol_chance, stim_chance, gun_mods (random parts fitted to the gun), medkit_rarity (multipliers on the medkit roll), gun_durability; leave a field out to keep the faction kit's. tier_weights: by map difficulty (MapInfo.difficulty 1-5), the weight of each tier. schedule: budget (AI PMCs in a raid, by map), late_share (share of them that arrive mid-raid, at least 1), late_squads (how many squads they come as), late_window (raid share they arrive in), late_falloff (above 1: earlier arrivals likelier), late_retry and late_give_up (seconds: a late arrival with nowhere to spawn tries again, and stops trying). route: travel routes along walls and cover (sample_spacing and hug_radius in metres, max_detour: the longest a route may be against the plain path, waypoint_reach in metres). loot: min_value (roubles: cheaper finds are left), give_up (seconds), follower_radius (metres from the leader a follower loots a POI's containers in). heal: quiet_seconds (nothing seen or heard this long before treating), below (share of total HP under which lost HP is treated), max_treatments, cooldown. combat: spread (metres between squad mates' cover), flank_chance (one member flanks), regroup_distance and regroup_timeout. plan: tick (seconds between plan checks), extract_margin (seconds kept in hand to reach the extract), detour_estimate (path length against a straight line), min_stay (a late arrival's seconds in the raid at least), noise_memory (seconds before it rolls again for the same noise maker), hunt_seconds, avoid_quiet, avoid_distance, avoid_give_up (seconds hiding without it getting quiet before it stops waiting: a threat in its way makes it skip that POI), avoid_calm (seconds it then doesn't hide again), rush_wait (seconds it waits at an event for the crate), poi_reach (metres from a POI's centre that count as there).
